name: small_revision_harness_execution
description: Route every H8B validation scenario unchanged to B0, B1, B2, and B3 and execute the four treatment adapters logically, without timing or storage measurement.

adapters.B0: append the synthetic vintage to the H6 workload and replay the B0 overwrite
adapters.B1: append the synthetic vintage to the H6 workload and replay the B1 full snapshots
adapters.B2: rank every candidate with the frozen H6B score of revised_source_id for synthetic rows; ties by vintage_date DESC, then source_id, then observation_id
adapters.B3: append the synthetic vintage; each synthetic observation reaches its cell through the H6C edge of the base observation it revises

baseline_check: replaying the H6 workload without injection must reproduce every manifested treatment state
invariants: each route recomputes its scenario payload checksum and matches the H8B route
all four treatments consume the same synthetic observation IDs for a scenario
the synthetic vintage is strictly later than every official vintage
no synthetic row carries BPS as producer or an official evidence level
baseline replay reproduces the manifested B0 B1 B2 and B3 states
B0 B1 and B3 serve the revised value in every injected cell
B3 recomputes exactly the injected cells and equals a full recomputation
B1 and B3 keep every official and synthetic observation addressable
no runtime or storage result is produced
